learning-kit data model and ERD

What learning-kit stores, where each file lives, how the records relate (ERD), which values may change and how, and the rules that keep the data consistent.

  • Updated2026-11-11
  • Scopeagentic-workflows/learning-kit · branch feat/learning-kit @ 5663e54
  • Doc set1 Architecture · 2 Use cases · 3 Sequences · 4 Data model · 5 Interfaces

How the data is stored

In short

There is no database. All state is plain JSON, JSONL and Markdown under one data home, readable in an editor and diffable in git. A topic is a folder; a path is a folder of topic references; sessions, the source bank, recall cards and the mistakes log are shared across topics. Keys are strings (slugs and prefixed ids), and relationships are id references between files, checked by lk on write. S1S2

  1. One writer path. Skills and front doors never edit these files directly: every structured write goes through an lk function, under the data-home lock, as an atomic replace. S2S3
  2. Append-only logs, rewritten documents. attempts.jsonl, srs-log.jsonl and mistakes.jsonl only grow. Everything else is a whole JSON document replaced on save.
  3. Derived, not duplicated. A path node's progress, the gate's spent items and "fresh" counts are computed from topic state and attempts every time, never stored twice. S4S5

Where every file lives

The data home is $LK_HOME, else home in ~/.learning-kit.json, else ~/learning. The tool repo holds no learning data. S6

ERD: learning content and paths

Read it as tables even though they are files. A topic owns its concepts, quiz items and note review. A path owns nodes, milestones and placement items, and each node points at a topic by slug. Sources are shared by everything. S7S8

ERD: quiz activity and memory

A session copies its quiz items in at creation, so later bank edits never change an old session. Applying a graded session fans out into attempts, mistakes and (for recall and checkpoints) recall-card updates. S10S11

Source, note review, config

  • Source (index.json → sources[]): id S####, url, norm_url, title, kind docs|spec|paper|book|blog|talk|course|code|forum|other, quality 1–3, topics[], fetched, chars, notes. The snapshot S####.md starts with an "untrusted content" comment; text is capped at 400,000 chars. S9
  • Note review: at, criteria{correctness, coverage, own_words, when_not, connections: {score, feedback}}, total, passed, missing_concepts[], summary, history[{at, total, passed}]. S17
  • Config: only overrides of DEFAULT_CONFIG (grader, gate, srs, server, speech_lang, agents, path, depth). S6

Every identifier format the code creates or accepts S2S10S18

IdentifierFormatExampleScope

Quiz item idq + 4 digits, sequential per topicq0007topic
Placement item idp + 3 digits, reassigned on each importp012path

Variant entry uid<origin>~v<4 hex>mvcc/q0007~v3fa1session
Placement entry uidpath:<path>/<pid>path:system-design/p004session
Session id<date>-<mode>-<key>-<4 hex>; service accepts ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,159}$, no ..2026-11-10-gate-mvcc-a1b2global

Windows device names (con, nul, com1 …) get -topic appended when slugified, and the CLI lowercases slug arguments so case-sensitive and case-insensitive filesystems behave the same. S18

How records change state

Topic stage

Nine stages. Moves out of quiz are made only by the gate; lk topic advance refuses them without --force. Each move is guarded by a file or score check. S13S19

Path node status (derived)

Computed on every read by learnpath.node_status, never stored S4

OrderConditionStatus
1An override exists for the nodetested_out or skipped
2No state.json for the node's topicnot_started
3Topic stage is scheduleddone
4Otherwisein_progress (with its stage)

A node is satisfied when done, tested_out or skipped, and ready when all its prereqs are satisfied. S4

Rules that keep the data consistent

Integrity rules and where they are enforced

RuleEnforced in
A quiz item's concept exists in the topic; its source_ids exist in the bankquiz.validate_item on validate and import S14
Merging concepts never changes an existing concept's status (mastery is earned through the gate)topics.merge_concepts S13
Gate items are fresh: an item attempted in any earlier gate never returns to a gatequiz.gate_attempted_ids, sessions.create_gate S5
Gate, placement and checkpoint: one open session per (mode, key); starting again resumes it (practice and recall always start fresh)sessions.find_open S10
Session side effects apply once, even with two finisherssessions.finish re-check under the lock S10
Prereqs point to earlier nodes only (list order is a learning order; no cycles); topics unique in a path; ≤ 15 nodeslearnpath.validate_plan S8
Record fields of a path are never overwritten by a draft; overrides and reviews of removed nodes are droppedlearnpath.import_plan S8
Sources are unique by normalised URL (scheme/host lowercased, trailing slash and tracking params removed)sources.normalize_url, sources.add S9
No lost updates across processes; no torn fileslock.locked, store._atomic_write S2S3
Known weak spotIf the process dies between graded and applied, re-running finish re-applies, so attempt lines can be duplicated. Making _apply idempotent is on the roadmap. S20
